response.sql: WITH budget_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), avg_spend AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_cost FROM budget_totals) SELECT AVG(bt.total_cost) AS avg_total_above_average, SUM(bt.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(bt.total_cost - a.avg_cost) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM budget_totals bt CROSS JOIN avg_spend a WHERE bt.total_cost > a.avg_cost;
